summary: Where the port was up to: the newest TrueVision release whose drawing changes reached ValeVision is TV v2.85.0 (20-Sep-2026, VV v2.68.0); the last VV port release was VV v2.70.0 (TV v2.83.0 top-bar fold). After that the VV side stopped. VV's only later release, v2.71.0 (per-scene lighting), went the other way and became TV v2.161.0. TrueVision then shipped 88 releases (v2.86.0-v2.172.0, 76 of them on 20-23 Sep). None reached VV: 78 were never considered, 7 are parked on Adam's sign-off, 1 is deliberate (v2.88.0, Project Admin), 1 is VV-origin and 1 is not drawing work. The port was not contiguous below the high-water mark either. The low-water mark is TV v2.28.0 (viewport snap move), and 18 releases between v2.28.0 and v2.85.0 are open or partial. These include flush joins (v2.37.0), the frame toggle (v2.38.0), the ortho depth-bias fault, which is live in VV (v2.38.1), extension lines (v2.41.0), plan doors (v2.42.0/v2.48.1), site plans (v2.48.0-v2.49.1), select-picks-move (v2.78.0), drawing planes (v2.82.0) and the partial v2.28.0/v2.39.0/v2.40.0/v2.58.2/v2.84.0. Appendix A classifies all 177 rows (172 TV headings, plus v2.33.0, which has no heading, and 4 unrecorded TV features VV ported): 55 PORTED, 6 PARTIAL, 14 PENDING-SIGNOFF, 83 NOT-CONSIDERED, 6 DELIBERATE (5 reopened by the identical-experience goal), 7 NOT-DRAWING, 4 VV-ORIGIN, 2 N/A. Each row gives the owning slice and the TV tests to port. The parity ledger records nothing after TV v2.87.0, and about 40 of its rows are stale or contradictory. Examples: it says 14 times that VV has no service worker, but VV runs under Whitecardopedia's worker, whose token has been unchanged since 18-Sep. It says VV lacks the Na__Verify__ harnesses, but VV has them (they pass today: 415 files, 517 modules). It records the scene-editor splits as closed when TV withdrew them, and it gives the loader contradictory back-port statuses. Re-checking the VV->TV back-ports in TV source: Add Viewport refresh fix, ThumbnailBake, pose-preserving mode release, Ground Floor Plan quick action, section filing and the loader are still open; the confirm dialog is half done (no DOM in TV Index.html); Pick Face/grip, the dimension splits, R2 upload, style rows and the Lantern Designer items have landed. The TV-side records (plan section 12, several PORT NOTEs, two devlog claims) are also stale. Module versions are not comparable across the apps because VV restarts ported modules at 1.0.0; the per-module watermark was computed from dev-log dates (261 module pairs). Recommended procedure: coding agents never touch the ledger or devlog; they return Port Records and write {{VVREL:WP}} tokens. A single Parity Scribe, serialised per wave, allocates VV versions from a fresh devlog read, resolves the tokens, writes devlog entries and updates a restructured ledger (Module Register + Release Watermark + Decisions + Back-ports + Archive). A new Na__Verify__PortNotes__ harness guards the convention. TV edits happen only in Adam-approved packages.

findings.title: Ortho linework depth-bias fault (TV v2.38.1) is live in VV base images

Through the drawing ortho cameras TV measured it as about 75 mm, which draws lines through faces in plan and elevation base images. TV 1.3.0 uses RenderConfig__Linework__OrthoDepthBiasMm (2 mm) via abs(projectionMatrix[2][2])/2 for orthographic cameras and leaves perspective unchanged.

findings.title: Module version numbers are not comparable between the apps
findings.detail: VV restarts each ported module at its own 1.0.0 and keeps the TV version only in prose (VV LinkNoodle 1.0.0 = TV 1.2.0). So drift_all tv_ver vs vv_ver cannot be compared, 'same version' ledger claims cannot be checked, and out-of-order VV logs mislead tools. This is why the S11 per-module watermark had to be computed from dev-log dates.
findings.recommendation: D-S11-03: when a file is taken whole, adopt TV's module version, and require a PORT NOTE line '- Source version: <TV x.y.z> (TrueVision3D v2.N.0)'. The Module Register keeps the pair; WP-S11-03 enforces it.

findings.title: Swarm needs a single-writer ledger/devlog procedure
findings.detail: The ledger, the VV devlog, index.html, the loader STYLESHEETS list, the LE AppConfig and the ConfigState units are touched by almost every package, and parallel appends will collide and mis-number releases. Procedure (report B10): coding agents return Port Records and write {{VVREL:WP-id}} tokens. One Parity Scribe per wave reads the devlog top fresh, allocates versions, resolves tokens, writes entries and ledger rows, and records the service worker decision. TV docs change only with Adam's approval.
findings.recommendation: Adopt B10 and Appendix C templates; run WP-S11-04 after every wave; the integration gate is both Na__Verify__ harnesses plus the ported tests.
findings.evidence: Report B10 / Appendix C; user memory note 'Re-read devlog top before adding a version'; ledger L1116-1118 path convention.
